title: Problem Set 1: Multi-layer Cylindrical Steam Pipe Insulation Optimization
description: Determine the optimal insulation thickness for high-pressure steam pipes in an energy plant, minimizing thermal loss and surface condensation risk. Calculate heat flux and annual fuel cost savings.
instructions: Submit physical neatly handwritten solution paper in LT-2 Department Assignment Box, or submit your group summary writeup here.

title: Design Task 1: Single Reduction Spur Gearbox Assembly & Stress Analysis
description: Design an enclosed single-reduction spur gearbox transmitting 15 kW at 1440 rpm input speed. Select 20-degree full-depth teeth, determine face width, and verify contact endurance life.
instructions: Prepare complete calculation sheets with isometric CAD drawing sheet to be submitted in the Mechanical Engineering CAD laboratory.
